; RUN: llc < %s -mtriple=wasm32-unknown-unknown -exception-model=wasm -mattr=+exception-handling -wasm-enable-eh -wasm-enable-sjlj=false -wasm-use-legacy-eh=false -O2 -print-after=wasm-private-scalar-stores -o /dev/null 2>&1 | FileCheck %s --check-prefix=OFF --allow-empty
; OFF-NOT: IR Dump After WebAssembly strict private scalar store elimination

target triple = "wasm32-unknown-unknown"

@backup = external global i32
@atomic = external global i32

declare void @touch(ptr)
declare void @use_i32(i32)
declare i32 @__gxx_wasm_personality_v0(...)
declare void @llvm.lifetime.start.p0(i64 immarg, ptr nocapture)

; Private slot facts survive normal invokes with OTHER pointer arguments and
; other-object volatile/atomic/fence operations. The ordering operations, calls,
; all unwind edges and the handler's private load remain unchanged.
; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @normal_invokes(
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: store ptr %p, ptr %pointer
; CHECK: invoke void @touch(ptr %other)
; CHECK: normal:
; CHECK: store volatile i32 3, ptr @backup
; CHECK: store atomic i32 4, ptr @atomic monotonic
; CHECK: fence seq_cst
; CHECK-NOT: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK-NOT: store ptr %p, ptr %pointer
; CHECK: invoke void @touch(ptr %other)
; CHECK: done:
; CHECK-NOT: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK-NOT: store ptr %p, ptr %pointer
; CHECK: load i32, ptr %slot
; CHECK: load ptr, ptr %pointer
; CHECK: call void @touch(
; CHECK: ret i32
; CHECK: catchswitch within none
; CHECK: catchpad within
; CHECK: catchret from
; CHECK: load i32, ptr %slot
define i32 @normal_invokes(ptr %other, i32 %v, ptr %p) personality ptr @__gxx_wasm_personality_v0 {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  %pointer = alloca ptr, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  store ptr %p, ptr %pointer, align 4
  invoke void @touch(ptr %other) to label %normal unwind label %dispatch
normal:
  store volatile i32 3, ptr @backup, align 4
  store atomic i32 4, ptr @atomic monotonic, align 4
  fence seq_cst
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  store ptr %p, ptr %pointer, align 4
  invoke void @touch(ptr %other) to label %done unwind label %dispatch
done:
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  store ptr %p, ptr %pointer, align 4
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  %pointer.result = load ptr, ptr %pointer, align 4
  call void @touch(ptr %pointer.result)
  ret i32 %result
dispatch:
  %cs = catchswitch within none [label %handler] unwind to caller
handler:
  %pad = catchpad within %cs [ptr null]
  catchret from %pad to label %caught
caught:
  %caught.result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %caught.result
}

; At a join the last textual predecessor cannot supply facts from one arm.
; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @join_reset(
; CHECK: right:
; CHECK: store i32 %w, ptr %slot
; CHECK: join:
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: load i32, ptr %slot
define i32 @join_reset(i1 %condition, i32 %v, i32 %w, ptr %other) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  br i1 %condition, label %left, label %right
left:
  call void @touch(ptr %other)
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %left.value = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  call void @use_i32(i32 %left.value)
  br label %join
right:
  store i32 %w, ptr %slot, align 4
  %right.value = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  call void @use_i32(i32 %right.value)
  br label %join
join:
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}

; The header's store is necessary after every backedge overwrites the slot.
; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @loop_reset(
; CHECK: loop:
; CHECK: phi i32
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: br i1 {{%[-a-zA-Z$._0-9]+}}, label %body, label %exit
; CHECK: body:
; CHECK: store i32 [[LOOP_WRITE:%[-a-zA-Z$._0-9]+]], ptr %slot
; CHECK-NEXT: {{%[-a-zA-Z$._0-9]+}} = add i32 [[LOOP_WRITE]], 1
; CHECK-NEXT: br label %loop
; CHECK: exit:
; CHECK: load i32, ptr %slot
define i32 @loop_reset(i32 %v, i32 %limit) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  br label %loop
loop:
  %iteration = phi i32 [ 0, %entry ], [ %next, %body ]
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %more = icmp ult i32 %iteration, %limit
  br i1 %more, label %body, label %exit
body:
  %next = add i32 %iteration, 1
  store i32 %next, ptr %slot, align 4
  br label %loop
exit:
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}

; Distinct Value* operands are not equated. Undef/poison writes are retained
; and invalidate that slot rather than becoming a stored-value equivalence.
; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @different_and_unknown_rhs(
; CHECK: store i32 %a, ptr %slot
; CHECK: store i32 %b, ptr %slot
; CHECK: store i32 undef, ptr %slot
; CHECK: store i32 %b, ptr %slot
; CHECK: store i32 poison, ptr %slot
; CHECK: store i32 %b, ptr %slot
define i32 @different_and_unknown_rhs(i32 %a, i32 %b) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %a, ptr %slot, align 4
  store i32 %b, ptr %slot, align 4
  store i32 undef, ptr %slot, align 4
  store i32 %b, ptr %slot, align 4
  store i32 poison, ptr %slot, align 4
  store i32 %b, ptr %slot, align 4
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}

; An exceptional/atomic/lifetime/GEP/escaping use rejects the ENTIRE slot,
; including otherwise-simple stores. Nothing follows aliasing addresses.
; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @ineligible_objects(
; CHECK: store volatile i32 %v, ptr %volatile
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %volatile
; CHECK: store atomic i32 %v, ptr %atomic.slot monotonic
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %atomic.slot
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %escaped
; CHECK: call void @touch(ptr %escaped)
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %escaped
; CHECK: call void @llvm.lifetime.start.p0
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %lifetime
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %lifetime
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %gep.slot
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %gep.slot
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %array
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %array
define i32 @ineligible_objects(i32 %v, i32 %offset) {
entry:
  %volatile = alloca i32, align 4
  %atomic.slot = alloca i32, align 4
  %escaped = alloca i32, align 4
  %lifetime = alloca i32, align 4
  %gep.slot = alloca i32, align 4
  %array = alloca i32, i32 2, align 4
  store volatile i32 %v, ptr %volatile, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %volatile, align 4
  store atomic i32 %v, ptr %atomic.slot monotonic, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %atomic.slot, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %escaped, align 4
  call void @touch(ptr %escaped)
  store i32 %v, ptr %escaped, align 4
  call void @llvm.lifetime.start.p0(i64 4, ptr %lifetime)
  store i32 %v, ptr %lifetime, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %lifetime, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %gep.slot, align 4
  %indexed = getelementptr i8, ptr %gep.slot, i32 %offset
  store i32 %v, ptr %indexed, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %gep.slot, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %array, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %array, align 4
  %result = load i32, ptr %escaped, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}

; Only the layout-next unique-predecessor arm inherits. Facts from an already
; visited sibling must not leak into this later arm, even if the first entry
; store would allow a stronger dominator-based optimizer to remove the write.
; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @layout_gap(
; CHECK: sibling:
; CHECK: store i32 %w, ptr %slot
; CHECK: target:
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
define i32 @layout_gap(i1 %condition, i32 %v, i32 %w, ptr %other) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  br i1 %condition, label %target, label %sibling
sibling:
  store i32 %w, ptr %slot, align 4
  %sibling.value = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  call void @use_i32(i32 %sibling.value)
  call void @touch(ptr %other)
  ret i32 %sibling.value
target:
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}

; RUN: llc < %s -mtriple=wasm32-unknown-unknown -exception-model=wasm -mattr=+exception-handling -wasm-enable-eh -wasm-enable-sjlj -wasm-use-legacy-eh=false -O2 -stop-after=wasm-private-scalar-stores -print-after=wasm-private-scalar-stores -o /dev/null 2>&1 | FileCheck %s
;
; These negative IR cases stop at the actual target pass. They do not claim
; Wasm supports executing every special stack/ABI/asm operation below.

target triple = "wasm32-unknown-unknown"

@taken = global ptr blockaddress(@address_taken, %target)

declare i32 @again() returns_twice
declare void @touch(ptr)
declare ptr @llvm.stacksave.p0()
declare void @llvm.stackrestore.p0(ptr)
declare void @llvm.localescape(...)
declare void @llvm.lifetime.start.p0(i64 immarg, ptr nocapture)
declare i32 @__gxx_wasm_personality_v0(...)

; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @returns_twice_barrier(
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: call i32 @again()
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
define i32 @returns_twice_barrier(i32 %v) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %again = call i32 @again()
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  %observed = add i32 %result, %again
  ret i32 %observed
}

; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @stackrestore_barrier(
; CHECK: call ptr @llvm.stacksave.p0
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: call void @llvm.stackrestore.p0
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
define i32 @stackrestore_barrier(i32 %v) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  %saved = call ptr @llvm.stacksave.p0()
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  call void @llvm.stackrestore.p0(ptr %saved)
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}

; An intrinsic involving a DIFFERENT object is still a special-control barrier.
; The eligible slot itself has only direct simple memory users.
; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @other_intrinsic_barrier(
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: call void @llvm.lifetime.start.p0
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
define i32 @other_intrinsic_barrier(i32 %v) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  %other = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  call void @llvm.lifetime.start.p0(i64 4, ptr %other)
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  call void @touch(ptr %other)
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}

; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @inline_asm_barrier(
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: call void asm sideeffect
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
define i32 @inline_asm_barrier(i32 %v) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  call void asm sideeffect "", "~{memory}"()
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}

; A callbr's normal destination has one predecessor and is layout-next, but
; cannot inherit the pre-callbr value. The indirect destination remains intact.
; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @callbr_barrier(
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: callbr void asm sideeffect
; CHECK: normal:
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: indirect:
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
define i32 @callbr_barrier(i32 %v) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  callbr void asm sideeffect "", "!i"() to label %normal [label %indirect]
normal:
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  br label %done
indirect:
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  br label %done
done:
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}

; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @operand_bundle_barrier(
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: call void @touch(ptr %other) [ "deopt"(i32 0) ]
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
define i32 @operand_bundle_barrier(i32 %v, ptr %other) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  call void @touch(ptr %other) [ "deopt"(i32 0) ]
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}

; A dynamic allocation invalidates prior facts, while a later ordinary call
; with that OTHER allocation does not invalidate the newly established value.
; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @dynamic_alloca_barrier(
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: alloca i8, i32 %count
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: call void @touch(ptr %dynamic)
; CHECK-NOT: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: load i32, ptr %slot
define i32 @dynamic_alloca_barrier(i32 %v, i32 %count) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %dynamic = alloca i8, i32 %count, align 16
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  call void @touch(ptr %dynamic)
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}

; Local escape on another allocation cannot expose %slot, but is nevertheless
; a mandatory special-stack barrier. The escaped allocation is never eligible.
; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @localescape_barrier(
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: call void (...) @llvm.localescape(ptr %escaped)
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
define i32 @localescape_barrier(i32 %v) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  %escaped = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  call void (...) @llvm.localescape(ptr %escaped)
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}

; Funclet calls are operand-bundle barriers even for an otherwise private slot.
; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @funclet_barrier(
; CHECK: handler:
; CHECK: catchpad within
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: call void @touch(ptr %other) [ "funclet"(token %pad) ]
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
define i32 @funclet_barrier(i32 %v, ptr %other) personality ptr @__gxx_wasm_personality_v0 {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  invoke void @touch(ptr %other) to label %done unwind label %dispatch
done:
  %normal = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %normal
dispatch:
  %cs = catchswitch within none [label %handler] unwind to caller
handler:
  %pad = catchpad within %cs [ptr null]
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  call void @touch(ptr %other) [ "funclet"(token %pad) ]
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  catchret from %pad to label %caught
caught:
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}

; Special ABI storage is rejected even when its direct memory users are simple.
; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @inalloca_ineligible(
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
define i32 @inalloca_ineligible(i32 %v) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca inalloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}

; CHECK-LABEL: define ptr @swifterror_ineligible(
; CHECK: store ptr %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: store ptr %v, ptr %slot
define ptr @swifterror_ineligible(ptr %v) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca swifterror ptr, align 4
  store ptr %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  store ptr %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %result = load ptr, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret ptr %result
}

; An address-taken block cannot inherit the apparent direct predecessor trace.
; CHECK-LABEL: define i32 @address_taken(
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
; CHECK: target:
; CHECK: store i32 %v, ptr %slot
define i32 @address_taken(i32 %v) {
entry:
  %slot = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  br label %target
target:
  store i32 %v, ptr %slot, align 4
  %result = load i32, ptr %slot, align 4
  ret i32 %result
}
